verdict.rationale: Apify's core value proposition is building 'Actors' (custom scraping scripts) deployed serverlessly on their platform, with docs covering development toolkits, SDKs (JS/Python), CLI for terminal control, scheduling, monitoring, and migration guides for existing projects. Community feedback corroborates real-world usage of the platform for custom scraping projects without infrastructure management. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks of deployment ease/scaling limits, and more recent community validation beyond older HN threads.
